basic_details.short_information: NHPC Limited has released the NHPC Trainee Officer Recruitment 2026 notification for 44 vacancies in Human Resources (HR), Public Relations (PR) and Law, including three posts under a special recruitment drive for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD). Recruitment will be based on UGC NET June 2026 and CLAT PG 2026 scores, followed by a Group Discussion and Personal Interview.

content_sections.heading: NHPC Recruitment 2026 Notification
content_sections.text: The notification specifies that HR and Public Relations vacancies will be filled through UGC NET June 2026 scores, while Law vacancies require a valid CLAT PG 2026 score. Scores from other examination sessions or years will not be accepted. Candidates appointed through this recruitment will undergo one year of training before being absorbed as Officers, subject to successful completion of the training period. NHPC Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: NHPC Trainee Officer Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: NHPC has announced 44 Trainee Officer vacancies, comprising 41 vacancies listed under Table 1-B of the official notification and three additional vacancies under the special recruitment drive for PwBD candidates. The category-wise table excludes the three additional special PwBD recruitment vacancies. The ST vacancy for Trainee Officer (Law) in NHPC is a backlog vacancy from Recruitment No. NH/Rectt./05/2023-24. Candidates applying under the special recruitment drive should refer to the official notification for the identified benchmark disability categories. The Category B HR vacancy is a backlog vacancy. Reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities is horizontal.

tables.caption: Special Recruitment Drive for PwBD Candidates

content_sections.heading: NHPC Trainee Officer Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must be Indian nationals, possess the prescribed full-time regular educational qualification and have a valid score in the relevant UGC NET June 2026 or CLAT PG 2026 examination. Final-year students are not eligible to apply. Candidates applying for the HR discipline must possess one of the following prescribed full-time regular two-year qualifications from a recognized Indian university or eligible AICTE-approved institution: Postgraduate Degree, Postgraduate Diploma or Postgraduate Program in Management with specialization in Human Resource, Human Resource Management, Human Resource Management and Labor Relations, Industrial Relations, Personnel Management, Personnel Management and Industrial Relations, or Industrial Relations and Personnel Management. Master of Social Work with specialization in Personnel Management and Industrial Relations. Master of Human Resource and Organizational Developments (MHROD), now known as MBA HRD. MBA with specialization in Human Resource as a major subject. Candidates holding qualifications in disciplines not specifically listed in the notification are not eligible, even if those disciplines are considered equivalent.

rows.required_qualification: Two-year full-time regular postgraduate qualification in prescribed HR, personnel management or industrial relations disciplines; eligible MSW, MHROD, MBA HRD or MBA with HR as a major subject
Two-year full-time regular PG Degree or PG Diploma in Communication, Mass Communication, Journalism or Public Relations
Full-time regular three-year LLB or five-year integrated professional Law degree from a recognized university or institution recognized by the Bar Council of India

content_sections.heading: NHPC Recruitment Through UGC NET and CLAT PG 2026
content_sections.text: NHPC accepts UGC NET June 2026 scores for Trainee Officer (HR) and Trainee Officer (PR) posts. Candidates applying for Trainee Officer (Law) must possess a valid CLAT PG 2026 score. Only scores from the specified examination session are valid for this recruitment. Applications containing an invalid UGC NET June 2026 or CLAT PG 2026 registration number will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: NHPC Trainee Officer Salary 2026
content_sections.text: NHPC Trainee Officers will receive a pay scale of Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 1,60,000 under E2 Grade with a 3% increment structure (IDA). The approximate total annual emoluments for newly appointed candidates will be Rs. 16 to 17 lakh. In addition to basic pay, employees will receive benefits and allowances in accordance with company rules, including: Dearness Allowance (DA) House Rent Allowance (HRA) Cafeteria Allowance Performance Related Pay (PRP) Medical facilities Provident Fund, pension and gratuity After successfully completing one year of training, candidates will be absorbed as Officers in the same pay scale and placed on probation for one year.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: General, EWS and OBC Non-Creamy Layer candidates must pay a non-refundable application fee of Rs. 708, including applicable taxes. SC, ST, Women, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from payment of the registration fee. Additional bank charges, processing charges and applicable GST on such charges, if any, must be borne by the candidate. The application fee is non-refundable. Candidates applying for Trainee Officer (Law) vacancies in both NHPC and NHDC must submit separate applications and pay the applicable fee separately for each application.

content_sections.heading: NHPC Trainee Officer Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of shortlisting based on UGC NET June 2026 or CLAT PG 2026 marks, followed by a Group Discussion and Personal Interview. The qualifying examination score carries 75% weightage in the final selection process. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their marks in the relevant UGC NET June 2026 or CLAT PG 2026 examination. Normally, candidates numbering up to five times the available vacancies will be shortlisted for Group Discussion and Personal Interview. Candidates securing equal marks in the same discipline and category at the shortlisting threshold may be called even if the prescribed ratio is exceeded. Shortlisted candidates must submit the required consent form and attend the Group Discussion and Personal Interview. Candidates may also be required to undergo an online or offline psychometric assessment, the results of which will be used as an input during the interview. Final selection will be based on composite merit, applicable reservation requirements, document verification and other prescribed eligibility conditions. Selected candidates must satisfy NHPC or NHDC medical fitness requirements. There is no separate qualifying cutoff for Group Discussion. Candidates must secure the prescribed minimum combined score in Group Discussion and Personal Interview to be considered for empanelment. If two or more candidates secure the same final marks, the older candidate will receive preference in determining the merit position.

content_sections.heading: Service Agreement and Surety Bond
content_sections.text: Selected candidates must execute a service agreement and surety bond to complete a minimum of four years of service with the company, including the training period.

content_sections.heading: NHPC Trainee Officer Job Location
content_sections.text: Selected Trainee Officers may be posted at NHPC projects, power stations, offices, joint ventures or subsidiary companies in various parts of India or abroad. The placement will be determined according to organizational requirements. Candidates interested in similar public sector and government employment opportunities can also check the latest government job notifications .

content_sections.heading: NHPC Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Online registration for NHPC Trainee Officer posts will begin at 10:00 AM on 27 November 2026. The application window will close at 5:00 PM on 26 December 2026. The Group Discussion and Personal Interview schedule will be communicated to shortlisted candidates through their registered email addresses.

content_sections.heading: NHPC Trainee Officer Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: The online application facility for NHPC Trainee Officer Recruitment 2026 is scheduled to open on 27 November 2026 at 10:00 AM. Candidates with the prescribed qualifications and valid qualifying examination scores can apply through nhpcindia.com until 26 December 2026 at 5:00 PM. Only online applications will be accepted. Candidates are not required to send printed application forms or supporting documents through the post. Candidates must upload readable scanned documents. Incomplete applications or applications containing invalid qualifying examination registration numbers are liable to be rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NHPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 26 December 2026. Applications opened on 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NHPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 44 vacancies: 25 Trainee Officer (HR) (NHPC Vacancy), 2 Trainee Officer (PR) (NHPC Vacancy), 12 Trainee Officer (Law) (NHPC Vacancy), 2 Trainee Officer (Law) (NHDC Vacancy).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NHPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 26 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: UR/EWS/OBC (NCL): Rs. 600 plus applicable taxes (i.e. Rs. 708). SC/ST/Women/PwBD/Ex-servicemen: Nil (no registration fee).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 30 years (as on Last date of application (26-12-2026)). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC (NCL) 3 years, PwBD - General 10 years, PwBD - OBC (NCL) 13 years, PwBD - SC/ST 15 years, Domiciled in Jammu & Kashmir 01.01.1980 to 31.12.1989 5 years, Ex-servicemen As per Government guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 50,000-3%-1,60,000 (IDA) for Trainee Officer (HR) (NHPC Vacancy), Rs. 50,000-3%-1,60,000 (IDA) for Trainee Officer (PR) (NHPC Vacancy), Rs. 50,000-3%-1,60,000 (IDA) for Trainee Officer (Law) (NHPC Vacancy), Rs. 50,000-3%-1,60,000 (IDA) for Trainee Officer (Law) (NHDC Vacancy).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Trainee Officer (HR): full-time two-year PG degree/diploma/programme in HR-related specialisation or MSW (Personnel Management & Industrial Relations) or MHROD or MBA (HR), 60% marks. Trainee Officer (PR): full-time two-year PG degree/diploma in Communication/Mass Communication/Journalism/Public Relations, 60% marks. Trainee Officer (Law): full-time professional law degree (3 years LLB or 5 years integrated), 60% marks. Valid UGC NET June-2026 (HR, PR) or CLAT (PG)-2026 (Law) score needed. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only Indian Nationals can apply. SC/ST/PwBD candidates need 50% marks in the qualifying examination to apply. Selected candidates should be medically fit as per NHPC/NHDC guidelines.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Final year appearing students. Candidates without a valid UGC NET June-2026 / CLAT (PG)-2026 score. Candidates with qualification in any discipline other than those listed for the post.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Marks in the corresponding paper of UGC NET June-2026 / CLAT (PG)-2026. Shortlisting in order of merit for Group Discussion and Personal Interview (not more than 5 times the vacancies). Group Discussion and Personal Interview. Empanelment on final score (UGC NET/CLAT (PG) 75%, GD 5%, PI 20%).
